# ui-ux-pro-max

A design-intelligence reference: styles, palettes, font pairings, chart types and UX rules as
searchable data rather than prose.

## When to use

Building or reviewing any interface — landing page, dashboard, admin panel, mobile app — when you want
choices grounded in a reference instead of invented on the spot.

## What's inside

CSV datasets (styles, colours, typography, icons, charts, product types, UX guidelines, per-stack
performance notes) plus scripts to query them, across 13 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI,
React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui and more).

The rules are ordered by impact, and the top of that order is not aesthetics: accessibility first
(4.5:1 contrast, visible focus, tab order matching visual order), then touch and interaction (44x44px
targets, buttons disabled during async work, errors next to the problem), then performance and layout.
Style selection sits seventh.

## Caveats

The largest skill here (~570 KB). It is a reference, not an art director — for a distinctive look
start from a concept, then use this to keep it accessible and consistent.
